summary: Executed focused recurring-deployment reproductions for split frontend-build layout versus repository-shaped layout; reproduced path portability weakness without claiming cloud root cause.

critical.issue: Production CRACO evaluates python path as path.resolve(__dirname, '../scripts/package_local_engine.py'). In split disposable layout (frontend-build/app), this resolves to /tmp/.../frontend-build/scripts/package_local_engine.py and fails with ENOENT.

integration_issues.issue: When package_local_engine.py is invoked from workspace/scripts while frontend COPY target is frontend-build/app, restored wheel assets and rewritten game.zip/manifest are applied to workspace/frontend/public/local-runtime, not frontend-build/app/public/local-runtime.

action_items: Make CRACO production hook independent from fixed ../scripts relative location (single authoritative script path contract for build stage).

Add explicit target-directory contract for package_local_engine.py (source-root/public-dir args) so generated/restored artifacts always land in the frontend artifact directory used by the active build stage.
Use next cloud run logs to map failing Docker RUN exactly; current findings prove portability weakness only, not confirmed cloud failing step.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/craco.config.js embeds repository shape assumption via __dirname + ../scripts path; this is brittle under split/multi-stage layouts.

scripts/package_local_engine.py derives ROOT from script location and writes PUBLIC under ROOT/frontend/public/local-runtime, coupling output to checkout shape rather than active frontend build context.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All six focused tests passed. Verified repo-shaped CRACO production hook still passes locally. Verified split-layout reproducer fails exactly on missing /frontend-build/scripts/package_local_engine.py and verified source/build divergence for wheel restoration output. No UI/API/auth tests executed by scope.
rca of the issue: Reproduction steps: (1) Create disposable split layout with /tmp/.../workspace containing scripts/backend/frontend/public and /tmp/.../frontend-build/app containing craco.config.js + public + symlinked node_modules. (2) Run NODE_ENV=production node -e "require('./craco.config.js')" under frontend-build/app; observed exact failure: python3 can't open /tmp/.../frontend-build/scripts/package_local_engine.py and Node exits 1. (3) Remove wheels from both workspace/frontend/public/local-runtime and frontend-build/app/public/local-runtime; run python3 workspace/scripts/package_local_engine.py; wheels restored only in workspace runtime, build runtime remains without .whl files. Mitigation: establish explicit build-path contract for both CRACO hook and packaging script output path.
